Type Craftable Consumable · Item 1

Frequency once, then the Charm crumbles to ash

Price 4 gp

Usage held in 1 hand

Bulk L

Activate 1 action (concentrate, manipulate)

A one-use prepared item, written during downtime, that stores a single casting of Static (as a 24-hour ward-sense) or Name the Anchor for an ally without the class's training to trigger later. Any check the stored effect calls for uses the crafting Wardbreaker's proficiency rank and key ability modifier, not the user's own.

cinderfall.incomplete: The two abilities this item can store (Static, Name the Anchor) are themselves both INCOMPLETE above -- neither has a rule-element representation to package into a consumable. Separately, 'an item usable by anyone that resolves using a different, absent creature's proficiency rank and key ability' has no real pf2e precedent: ordinary wands/scrolls bake a fixed DC/attack bonus into the item at creation, not a live reference to another actor's current stats.
